description: This schematic diagram, headed "Diagram 0.1 Requirement E1", arranges six bordered text boxes with rows and a column of dots between them. The top box reads "Flat or room for residential purposes; Other parts of the same building". Beneath it, a line of solid black dots above a line of open circles is captioned "Separating floor". In the middle, a thick-bordered box on the left reads "Any dwelling-house, flat or room for residential purposes to which Requirement E1 applies". To its right, a vertical column of open circles is labelled "Separating wall", and beyond these a box reads "Adjoining dwelling-house, flat or room for residential purposes; Other parts of the same building; Adjoining building; Refuse chutes". Below the thick box a second "Separating floor" is shown as a row of solid black dots above a row of open circles, the solid dots covering only the left column and the open circles spanning both columns. The bottom row holds three boxes: "Flat or room for residential purposes", "Other parts of the same building", and a "KEY:" box in which a solid dot means "Impact sound insulation" and an open circle means "Airborne sound insulation".
